note: file-creation (file_event) telemetry. The rule needs TargetFilename to contain BOTH '_ca' AND 'mitmproxy-ca-cert.pem' (|all), which narrows it to ARTEX's '<dir>/_ca/mitmproxy-ca-cert.pem' layout (traffic/traffic.go). A standalone mitmproxy cert under .mitmproxy/ has the filename but not the '_ca' directory, so it must NOT match — that is the specificity the |all modifier buys.
